channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Hearth and Hamlet
item.description: Start with a campfire. Build a kingdom. Hearth and Hamlet is a medieval citybuilder clicker that blends resource management, in-depth upgrade trees and relaxing idle gameplay. Build your empire by researching new technologies, passing new laws, trading with far-off lands, and more.

item.title: Pizza House Simulator🍕
item.description: Run your dream pizzeria solo or with up to 6 players in chaotic online co-op multiplayer. Cook authentic pizzas, automate your kitchen, customize your restaurant, survive disasters, invest in stocks, gamble and build the ultimate Italian restaurant empire.

item.title: Project P.I.T.T.
item.description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

item.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam
item.description: Casey Jones joins the fight in this fast-paced, action-packed DLC! Battle through the Junkyard, face new enemies and bosses, and collect new powerful artifacts. Master Casey's hard-hitting moves and team up with the Turtles in co-op to take on the Punk Frogs!

item.title: WARNO - LANDJUT
item.description: Dive deep into amphibious warfare with the Danish-themed WARNO - LANDJUT expansion, featuring 8 brand-new divisions. Unlock an arsenal of new units, vehicles, and weapons, from the U.S. Marines to the F-14A Tomcat, Soviet Morskaya Pekhota naval infantry, the T-55AMD, and Kalmar hovercraft.

item.title: Cleared Hot
item.description: CLEARED HOT is a nostalgic helicopter shooter with satisfying physics and light tactical elements. Shoot, dodge, move your squad around the battlefield, and pick up almost anything with your rope and magnet.

item.title: Feed The Pit
item.description: JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit. Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!

item.title: MEMORIAPOLIS
item.description: Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows organically across 5 ages, from Antiquity to the Industrial Revolution. Manage resources, interact with factions, and shape your dynasty toward building a final Wonder with easy, normal, or hard difficulty levels.

item.title: Minecraft Legends
item.description: Discover the mysteries of Minecraft Legends, a new action strategy game. Explore a gentle land of rich resources and lush biomes on the brink of destruction. The ravaging piglins have arrived, and it’s up to you to inspire your allies and lead them in strategic battles to save the Overworld!

item.title: Motion Soccer PRO
item.description: Play, coach, or referee an 11v11 football match from any perspective. Experience the game as a player, coach, referee, or assistant referee. Includes full seasons, 1v1 to 11v11 multiplayer, and play with or without VR.

item.title: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop
item.description: Come on down to Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! WARNING: Untested genre not suitable for people with tentacles for arms or an aversion to dying horrifically. Side effects include improved reading comprehension under pressure and a furry fetish.

item.title: VOIDFACE
item.description: Face off in this challenging bullet-hell arena shooter, and try to clear bite-sized boss rush encounters. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast offensive and defensive spells, and kill everything that gets in your way.

item.title: BeastLink
item.description: BeastLink is a giant multiplayer Kaiju game featuring intense PvP or PvE combat. Humans, vehicles and Beasts collide in urban environments where everything & everyone can be destroyed. Build your Link, command giant Kaijus, and unleash devastating power before it consumes you!

item.title: Entropy
item.description: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

item.title: Exark
item.description: Exark is a run-based engine builder where you command a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, hire crew with unique skills, and exploit powerful synergies to survive your voyage to the rim of the world.

item.title: Last Drop
item.description: Finland 1994. The golden era of action is back. Dive into a gritty, story-driven sandbox where the 90s hit hard. Survive as Seppo "Zeze" Sahtivaara, drive retro cars, listen to a killer soundtrack, master intense 1v1 fights, and soak in pure nostalgia. Grab a beer and enjoy a Sauna by the lake.

item.title: Last Pirates: Die Together
item.description: An online co-op horror experience for up to 4 players. Use your elastic arms to grab valuable loot for your captain. But be careful, danger lurks around every corner trying to take your booty!

item.title: Planet Coaster 2: Parades Pack
item.description: Make spectacular moments happen with the Planet Coaster 2: Parades pack!

item.title: Stackmon
item.description: Stack, train and collect 100+ powerful Stackmon in this creature-collector with a card-stacking twist! Build your camp, challenge rival Scouts in combat and face the mysterious corruption spreading throughout your land.

item.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Samurai Armor
item.description: Samurai armor for TMNT: Splintered Fate playable characters

item.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Slash
item.description: Add Slash to the lineup– he’s big, he’s powerful, and he…loves candy? Use his claw and sheer strength to take down anyone in the way. Play with 5 new Artifacts while stomping through enemies with this latest playable character in TMNT: Splintered Fate.

item.title: Twisted Tower
item.description: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

item.title: Deponia
item.description: In Deponia, the world has degenerated into a vast garbage dump, in which the crotchety Rufus ekes out his sorry existence.
